summary: Learn predictive maintenance and reliability analytics with FMEA, MTBF, OEE, CMMS workflows, and dashboards. Build practical reliability plans.
lede: Predictive maintenance uses equipment condition data and failure history to guide maintenance before failures disrupt operations. For maintenance, reliability and asset professionals, this training develops skills in interpreting vibration and temperature trends, prioritizing failure modes with FMEA, and calculating reliability measures such as MTBF and OEE. Learners also practice turning findings into maintenance plans and reliability reports, with attention to data quality and spare-parts priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with equipment reliability, maintenance planning, asset health, and operational uptime across industrial, utilities, manufacturing, and facilities settings.
prerequisites: You should bring a basic understanding of maintenance terminology, failure records, or asset operations. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for hands-on analysis, and any sample CMMS reports, downtime logs, or asset registers will support the exercises. No programming background is required.
